long_biography.plain_text:
Ree entered business through Sortevit, the industrial laundry built by his father and sold to him. After military service, he helped expand the company, then sold it and worked in property. In 1981 he joined the newly established Den Blå Avis and expanded it across Denmark and Germany. The classified publication later made a profitable transition online.

Ree eventually controlled the Danish business, which included dba.dk and vehicle marketplace BilBasen before eBay bought the group in 2008. He then redeployed capital through a family office spanning private equity and real estate. Its purpose-driven organisations use safari tourism to fund conservation, endangered-species breeding and community programmes in Denmark and Kenya.
